summary: Activate AAP at first login on the Service Account tab with Client ID and Client secret (or Satellite credentials), accept the EULA; Automation Analytics is on by default and can be cleared under Settings > Automation Execution > System.
questions: How do I activate AAP with a service account?
How do I opt out of Automation Analytics?
What does Out of Compliance mean in AAP subscriptions?

answer_card.title: Activate AAP with credentials
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Log in to AAP and open the subscription wizard.
2. **Service Account** tab: enter **Client ID** and **Client secret** (or use the **Satellite** tab).
3. Pick the subscription, accept the EULA, click **Finish**.

Opt out of analytics: **Settings > Automation Execution > System**, clear *Gather data for Automation Analytics*, **Save**.
